chatgptPrompt:
Create a 9:16 (1080x1920) Short cover, focal point inside the centre safe area (clear of the bottom 25% and the right edge).
Subject: a soft 3-D voxel cut-away of a hair follicle: a round tunnel lined with rounded, touching warm skin-toned cells (light skin tone), a fine dark hair running down its middle. No face, no person, no spotted skin.
Composition: the tunnel fills the frame, the text over the upper third.
Lighting and treatment: soft studio light, a faint warm glow deeper down, very dark green-black ground (#0B1513), shallow depth of field, fine film grain.
Mood: quiet, calm, ASMR.
Text: "A doorway. A hair. A gland." in a small ivory (#F4EDE3) editorial serif, upper centre.
Scientific accuracy: a pore is the opening of a hair follicle; an oil gland empties sebum into it; an illustration, not to scale, not a photograph.
Avoid: no faces, arrows, circles, logos, watermarks, brand names, extra text, or anything that looks like a real medical photo.
Style: premium medical-editorial documentary illustration, soft voxel (rounded cube) look, distinctive and art-directed, not generic AI art.
